title: Approve What, Exactly? Effect Binding and Trusted Rendering for Agent Step-Up Authorization
description: AI agents now pause for approval before they send money, delete files or email outsiders, and that approval is usually treated as a second factor. We argue it is one only when compromising the agent cannot produce it and when it names exactly what it approves, and we test both conditions.
